gaps.noted_figures_differ: The reader's notes quote two figures from the catalog page that disagree, and the record's units add to one and state the other; no page read has settled which the program requires.

held.why: held: not collectable (collected_with_gaps, kb/_harvest_gap_census.py): with 'Plumbing 028' renamed to PLUMBNG 28, as its note has it, CRPNTRY 111C is still unplaced and unexplained, so coverage fails; a read of its section, or a missing-course note, is its lever

held: a noncredit program whose arithmetic reads no total (unstated), and its page prints VOC ED 460 where the state's file lists VOC ED 463, which its own note calls a 'possible renumbering or catalog error': which course the L1 row names is the college's to say in COCI

held: not collectable (collected_with_gaps, kb/_harvest_gap_census.py): 53 of 99 placed: its text holds only page 65, the Cal-GETC pattern's Areas 4 to 6, and its note says the heading and Areas 1 to 3 are on earlier pages; a page pin with its section's own pages is its lever (a reread)

records.words: Required courses listed in the semester sequence sum to 33 units, not the stated 38; the 'Electives 2' rows in Semesters I and III (4 units) are read as the 4 units of Major Electives. Reviewer should check the discrepancy.

program.section_heading: SOLAR THERMAL INSTALLATION & MAINTENANCE ▌ Associate in Science Degree
outcomes: Perform solar thermal installations and maintenance work utilizing hand and power tools.
Certify the proper and safe operation of solar thermal systems utilizing proper test equipment.
Calculate solar thermal system efficiency, performance, and installation costs.
careers: solar thermal installation and maintenance entry-level occupations
renewable energy and/or energy efficiency occupations
residential and commercial solar thermal and renewable energy-related occupations

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
